en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rough, wavy body of water with two small wooden rowboats in the foreground. Two people sit in one of the boats near the rocky or concrete shoreline, while another empty boat floats nearby. Across the water is a low, forested shoreline with scattered buildings and a distant smokestack. At the top of the card are printed captions in Russian, German, and another language identifying the place as Wöso in Estonia.
